verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' build overview directly documents dynamic variables and overrides for per-conversation customization, which is the capability this story asks for. The evidence is a single overview line, so the mechanics are unshown. Missing for 10: details on how variables and overrides are passed at call time (API/SDK/telephony parameters), coverage of per-caller context for inbound phone calls, examples of variables used in prompts or tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized

citations.quote: Use dynamic variables and overrides for per-conversation customization
